entries.77efba4f59e137ff: In May 2025 it formulated a medium-term management plan, and it states that in the coal business it will expand coal handling volume by strengthening the functions of its in-house call center and coal yard, and strengthen its response to customers' fuel conversion shift to biofuels. In the diamond business it aims to expand the scale of its polycrystalline diamond manufacturing and sales business through collaboration with its capital and business alliance partner, and to strengthen its entry into the fixed abrasive market; in the quarrying business, it aims to expand crushed stone supply by developing market needs in its supply areas and opening new sales areas; and in new businesses, it states it is forming a study team and preparing to launch. In the diamond business, it also lists making Trustwell Co., Ltd. a consolidated subsidiary among its future initiatives. As one of its new businesses, it has started work in the video content industry and states that it has decided to join the production committees of multiple anime and live-action films.
